input: Download offline maps for my hiking trip

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The geographic area to cover determines how many maps to download, their file size, and whether one app can cover it all or multiple are needed.
Whether this is for solo hiking or a group affects whether maps need to be shared across devices or synced with others.
The terrain type (mountain, forest, coastal, etc.) and trail difficulty influence which map app provides the most relevant detail and overlays.
Available storage on the device limits how many or how detailed the offline maps can be, which may force trade-offs.
The user may already have a preferred mapping app (AllTrails, Gaia GPS, Maps.me, Google Maps, etc.), which completely determines the download steps.
Knowing what features matter most — turn-by-turn navigation, topographic contours, waypoints, trail ratings — defines what 'good enough' looks like for the maps.
The device type (iOS vs Android) and when the trip starts affects which format is compatible and how urgently the download needs to happen.

gold.taskTitle: Download offline maps for hiking trip
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to download offline maps in preparation for an upcoming hiking trip, ensuring navigation is available without cell service.

questions.title: Which specific region or trail are you hiking?
questions.description: Identify the geographic area or named trail to determine what map tiles or regions need to be downloaded.

questions.title: Are you hiking solo or with others needing maps?
questions.description: Determine if maps need to be downloaded and shared across multiple devices or accounts.

questions.title: What type of terrain and trails does this trip involve?
questions.description: Understand whether the hike is on marked trails, backcountry, mountain ridges, etc., to recommend the right map detail level.

questions.title: How much free storage do you have on your device?
questions.description: Storage availability may limit the size or resolution of offline maps that can realistically be downloaded.

questions.title: Do you already use a preferred hiking or maps app?
questions.description: Knowing the app (e.g., AllTrails, Gaia GPS, Google Maps, Maps.me) determines the exact download steps to follow.

questions.title: Which map features matter most to you on the trail?
questions.description: Clarify whether topographic contours, waypoints, trail ratings, or turn-by-turn navigation are priorities, to ensure the right map type is selected.

questions.title: What device are you using, and when is your trip?
questions.description: Device type (iOS or Android) affects app availability, and the trip date sets urgency for completing the download.
